visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark shoulder-length hair, dressed in a black camisole and a pearl necklace, stands before a white bookshelf filled with perfumes and collectibles, holding a pink Dior blush bottle. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the Dior Forever Blush bottle, made of frosted glass with a black cap; a hand twists open the cap to reveal a slanted sponge-tip applicator. (3) The scene cuts to a close-up of the Giorgio Armani Luminous Silk Cheek Tint, a red-tinted cylindrical plastic bottle; the hand removes the cap to show a heart-shaped applicator tip. (4) The woman applies a swatch of the Dior blush to the back of her hand, demonstrating a thick, creamy rose-pink texture while speaking. (5) She uses a pink teardrop-shaped makeup puff to blend the product onto her right cheek, looking directly into the lens to show the matte finish. (6) A swatch of the Giorgio Armani blush is then applied to her other hand, appearing as a more liquid, translucent red with a slight shimmer. (7) She switches to a light blue makeup puff to apply and blend the Giorgio Armani blush on her left cheek, creating a dewy effect. (8) She holds both product bottles near her face simultaneously, demonstrating the distinct visual difference in finish—matte on the right and dewy on the left. (9) She points to different areas of her face while explaining the specific skin types and makeup styles each product is best suited for. (10) Finally, she holds up the Dior blush prominently as her favorite choice, smiling and gesturing towards the camera to invite comments.
